value.rationale: The Hamming product is a natural finite covariance domain; determining whether an oscillatory radial family remains positive semidefinite is prerequisite to covariance/sampling uses. The sharp phase diagram exhibits nonmonotone admissibility, disconnected acute-angle windows in every binary dimension but only nonbinary dimension two, and an exact rank-2(q−1) first-band projector at island collision. These quantitative geometric/structural facts are more than just computing the ordinary Krawtchouk eigenvalues.
